name: weworking
description: Unofficial WeWork hot-desk search and booking for AI agents: a Cloudflare Worker exposing a remote MCP server and a REST API.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Your sign-in for `/admin` (connect WeWork, mint API keys, read the audit log) and for approving OAuth clients. Use a long random passphrase.

QUOTE_SIGNING_KEY.description: Signs booking quotes, so a booking can only use a price the agent was shown. 32 random bytes as hex: run `openssl rand -hex 32`.

COOKIE_SIGNING_KEY.description: Signs the admin session cookie. 32 random bytes as hex: run `openssl rand -hex 32` again, **not** the same value as the quote key.
